data.long_meaning: The name Bambi is derived from the Italian word 'bambino', which means 'little boy'. It is a term of endearment and can be used for both boys and girls. In modern times, the name is often given to girls, signifying a sense of innocence and gentleness. The name Bambi carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Bambi usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
